thread:
maria: quick heads-up — after tonight's BMC firmware push to ap-southeast rack group, ~12 GPU hosts are failing POST with DRAM training errors and appear to be in a bootloop. OOB shows BMC responsive but nodes marked offline in the provisioner. pausing rollout?
kevin: saw this pop up in us-east-2-rack7 too. scheduler reports GPU pool down ~22%. customers on Dedicated will feel it.
ash (oncall-bot): Incident created automatically: INC-2026-4412345678 (severity P2) — tagging infra and billing.
ash (ash): stopped the rolling job at 4412345800, flagging rollback safe for devices with ID prefix gpu-apse2-4*. noticed secure boot bit toggled unexpectedly on 3 hosts during reflash — NVRAM write flapped. vendor support looped in.
priya: starting oncall runbook: connecting serial via jump host but `ipmitool sol` is intermittent. paste of last serial lines:
```
UEFI: DRAM training failed at stage 2 (DIMM 1)
UEFI: Memory map unstable, retrying training (attempt 3)
SecureBoot: variable write error, toggled 0 -> 1
Kernel panic: can't verify kernel image (secure boot state mismatch)
BMC: SOL active, no console after kernel panic
```
maria: can we hard-evict workloads and migrate to eu-west as a temporary backfill? need cost estimate before we decide — reserved capacity billing will be impacted.
kevin: kicked a migration wave. set scheduler flag `soft-evict=true` on cluster-provisioner to allow graceful draining. will throttle new allocations to avoid cascading evictions. rough delta: +$3k/hr if we push 100 GPUs to on-demand in eu-west.
ash (ash): vendor suggested two options: 1) reflash older BMC image + nvram regen: `fw-reflash --image v2.3.1 --nvram-reinit` (requires SOL/serial access) or 2) apply hotfix v2.3.2 (in QA, needs staging validation). hotfix ETA ~6h.
maria: @ash run option (1) on a 2-host canary first. if it stabilizes, expand. @priya coordinate jump host access and make sure auth keys are rotated.
priya: running canary on gpu-apse2-47 now. serial snippet:```
[  12.345678] DRAM training: success on second attempt
[  12.678901] SecureBoot var cleared, continuing boot
[  13.001234] Kernel: booted; device GPU enumerated
```
priya: canary looks promising — node came back and provisioner shows healthy. starting batch of 5 next.
dell-fw-bot: DellFW: Known issue DF-8823 — mem-training regression on populated HBM SKUs when BMC reflash occurs. Hotfix v2.3.2 in QA. Recommended immediate fallback: reapply v2.3.1 and run nvram reinit.
kevin: good catch. timeline: runbook to reflash 50 toggled hosts + scrub nvram on ~200 nodes that had any BMC write activity. need ops window and billing ping.
maria: declare customer-impacting notice for Dedicated accounts with affected pools. billing: log hours and cross-charge to incident. keep the rollout paused until hotfix validated.
priya: noted. creating incident doc and adding cost estimates and escalation contacts. tagging @support to notify impacted customer orgs.
kevin: after we finish remediation, we should add a preflash validation step to detect NVRAM write flaps and skip secureboot writes in the flasher. I've opened ENG-ops ticket.
maria: agreed. thanks all — prioritize safety over speed. :thumbsup:
